_doc: Fen kingfisher surface (Ch10, M4-A2P-056; docs/kb/art/wildlife.md). One slot for both meshes, like the gull's; write_materials.py writes assets/wildlife/kingfisher/materials/plumage.tres on game/world/wildlife/wildlife.gdshader. wing_pivot is build_kingfisher.py's shoulder (SHOULDER_X, SHOULDER_Y); head_pivot is its perched neck (printed by the build). A faster, shallower stroke than the gull's (a whirring wing), a slight rim sheen so the blue-green flash catches the fen's low light.
